scope: Real temporary-filesystem installation/update/uninstall with fixture application and Java launcher, desktop-file-validate and actual gio launch when available. Proves installer/integration behavior, not actual bundled game, WAN or runtime authenticity. All homes and installation targets are temporary.
checks: Selected absolute folder, including spaces, percent, quotes and dollar characters
User command symlink and application-menu entry
Owned update preserves all user files
Uninstall preserves saves/cache, changed files and empty user folders
Bounded archive extraction rejects traversal and out-of-tree links
Shortcut failure rollback and late foreign shortcut preservation
Tampered manifest cannot delete outside installation
